sc: '弱体 +18%', debuffAdd: 0.18 },\n  slow:   { name: 'スロウオーブ',   cost: 1600, reqQuest: 'q06', reqLegend: 140, desc: '鈍足 +22%', slowAdd: 0.22 },\n  venom:  { name: 'ドクオーブ',     cost: 1600, reqQuest: 'q05', reqLegend: 100, desc: '毒 +7', poisonAdd: 7 },\n  pierce: { name: 'カンツウオーブ', cost: 1800, reqQuest: 'q06', reqLegend: 140, desc: '防御貫通 +35%', pierceAdd: 0.35 },\n\n  // 炸裂: 主標的+近接2体。爆風: 画面上の全敵へ減衰ダメージ。\n  // color is presentation-only and lets the battle renderer distinguish the two orb effects.\n  spark:  { name: 'スパークオーブ', cost: 2400, reqQuest: 'q07', reqLegend: 200,\n            desc: '炸裂：主標的の近く2体へ45%ダメージ', area: { type: 'burst', targets: 2, multiplier: 0.45, color: '#E79032' } },\n  storm:  { name: 'ストームオーブ', cost: 5000, reqQuest: 'q09', reqLegend: 350,\n            desc: '爆風：主標的以外の全敵へ32%ダメージ', area: { type: 'all', multiplier: 0.32, color: '#7168C9' } },\n};\n\n// Job-tree unlock thresholds are the CURRENT job's level, not full mastery - branches open at\n// Lv5/9/14/18 of the job being left, each gated by a dedicated 転職試験 exam quest.\nconst EVOLVE_LV = { 2: 5, 3: 9, 4: 14, 5: 18 };\n\n// Servants (従者, DESIGN.md §19's 編成/派遣 companion system, renamed away from \"仲間\" - that\n// word is already the 4-hero party screen's name in this build, and reusing it for a second,\n// unrelated roster would be confusing). Scoped down to just the \"編成: 1-3体まで同行し、配置枠\n// とは別枠で支援効果を出す\" half - 派遣(sending one off to boost 採取/精錬) has no target system\n// since RESEARCH.md rejected both. Bought outright with gold (once each, no duplicates), then\n// toggled active/inactive up to SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE at a time; active ones apply a flat party-wide\n// multiplier/bonus, separate from the per-hero orb slot and from job mastery bonuses.\nconst SERVANTS = {\n  hikitsune: { name: '火狐', cost: 800, desc: '攻撃力 +8%', color: '#D8623F', atkMul: 1.08 },\n  fuusei: { name: '風精', cost: 800, desc: '攻撃間隔 -8%', color: '#7FD0C8', cdMul: 0.92 },\n  iwakoma: { name: '岩狛', cost: 1000, desc: '攻撃力 +6%', color: '#8A7550', atkMul: 1.06 },\n  kodama: { name: '木霊', cost: 700, desc: '任務報酬金 +10%', color: '#6FA85E', goldMul: 1.10 },\n};\nconst SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE = 2;\nfunction servantMul(key) {\n  let mul = 1;\n  for (const id of save.servants.active) { const v = SERVANTS[id][key]; if (v) mul *= v; }\n  return mul;\n}\nfunction buyServant(id) {\n  if (save.servants.owned.includes(id)) return false;\n  const cost = SERVANTS[id].cost;\n  if (save.gold < cost) return false;\n  save.gold -= cost;\n  save.servants.owned.push(id);\n  persist();\n  return true;\n}\nfunction toggleServant(id) {\n  const active = save.servants.active;\n  const at = active.indexOf(id);\n  if (at >= 0) { active.splice(at, 1); persist(); return true; }\n  if (active.length >= SERVANT_MAX_ACTIVE) return false;\n  active.push(id);\n  persist();\n  return true;\n}\n\nconst SAVE_VERSION = 2;\nconst SAVE_KEY = 'legend_boei_save_v2';\nfunction defaultHeroes() {\n  return START_JOBS.map(job => ({ job, lv: 1, exp: 0, weaponLv: 0, orb: null, history: [job] }));\n}\nconst DEFAULT_SAVE = {\n  version: SAVE_VERSION,\n  gold: 0,\n  legendScore: 0,         // 伝説度: cumulative, never spent, only ever grows\n  heroes: null,\n  mastered: [],           // jobId[] - every job any hero has ever evolved past, for party-wide bonuses\n  ownedOrbs: null,        // orbId[] - permanent collection. Once acquired, never consumed.\n  unlockedJobs: null,     // jobId[] - every job any hero has ever reached; any hero can freely\n                          // switch into these (president: 操作キャラ全員　解放済みの職業に転職できるように)\n  questCleared: {},\n  enemySeen: null,        // enemyId[] - gallery discovery; recorded when an enemy actually spawns\n  titles: [],\n  servants: null,         // { owned: servantId[], active: servantId[] } - see SERVANTS above\n  trainTickets: BAL.training.ticketMax,\n  trainCount: 0,\n  lastTicketAt: 0,\n  muted: false,\n};\n\n// Persistence: an Artifact's localStorage does NOT reliably survive reopening the page (the\n// runtime says as much - \"nothing is kept unless the page publishes it\"), which is exactly the\n// bug the president hit (進行が保存されない). The real save lives baked into the page itself:\n// window.SAVE_STATE is what this exact page was published with, and window.PAGE_TEMPLATE (see\n// build.ps1) is this page's own source with the save data left as a hole, so a running page can\n// regenerate a fresh, correctly self-referencing copy of itself and publish that via the\n// `artifact` capability. localStorage is kept too, but only as a same-tab/same-session nicety -\n// never the thing actually relied on to survive a reopen.\nlet save = load();\n\nfunction load() {\n  const embedded = window.SAVE_STATE;\n  let s;\n  // Rebuild V2 intentionally starts clean after the UI/battle reconstruction. Old embedded or\n  // local saves are not migrated: once this build is published, only SAVE_VERSION 2 data loads.\n  if (embedded && embedded.heroes && embedded.version === SAVE_VERSION) {\n    s = { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, ...embedded };\n  } else {\n    try {\n      const raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY));\n      s = (raw && raw.heroes && raw.version === SAVE_VERSION)\n        ? { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, ...raw }\n        : { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes() };\n    } catch {\n      s = { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes() };\n    }\n  }\n  // self-healing: older saves predate permanent orb ownership. Any orb already equipped in an\n  // old save is grandfathered into permanent ownership so no progress is lost.\n  if (!s.ownedOrbs) s.ownedOrbs = [];\n  for (const h of s.heroes) if (h.orb && !s.ownedOrbs.includes(h.orb)) s.ownedOrbs.push(h.orb);\n  // self-healing: older saves predate unlockedJobs, and every hero's CURRENT job must count as\n  // unlocked regardless of when it was reached\n  if (!s.unlockedJobs) s.unlockedJobs = [...START_JOBS];\n  for (const h of s.heroes) if (!s.unlockedJobs.includes(h.job)) s.unlockedJobs.push(h.job);\n  // self-healing: older saves predate per-hero history (president: なったことない職業だけ\n  // 表示して転職 - hide jobs a hero has already personally held from their own transfer list,\n  // since specialJobsAvailable() is party-wide and kept re-showing the same hybrid/special\n  // job to every hero once anyone unlocked it). Seed with at least the hero's current job.\n  for (const h of s.heroes) if (!h.history) h.history = [h.job];\n  // self-healing: older saves predate the monster-gallery discovery list.\n  if (!s.enemySeen) s.enemySeen = [];\n  // self-healing: older saves predate the servant roster\n  if (!s.servants) s.servants = { owned: [], active: [] };\n  return s;\n}\n\nlet saveDirty = false, publishTimer = null, artifactCapPromise;\n// A successful publish reloads THIS tab too (that's how the artifact capability works). Calling\n// flushNow() on every route('v-home') turned out to still be jarring even though the player was\n// \"already heading there\" (president: 初期画面に戻るバグがひどい) - home is visited constantly\n// (after every quest/purchase/menu-back), so that was really a reload-on-every-navigation bug in\n// practice. Fix: normal navigation only ever calls persist() (localStorage + dirty flag, no\n// reload). The real publish only fires when the player can't see it happen - tab hidden/closed\n// (see the visibilitychange/pagehide listeners in 50_main.js) - or as a last-resort long idle\n// fallback, never as a side effect of moving between screens.\nfunction persist() {\n  try { localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(save)); } catch { /* best-effort only */ }\n  saveDirty = true;\n  clearTimeout(publishTimer);\n  publishTimer = setTimeout(flushSave, 60000);\n}\nfunction flushNow() { clearTimeout(publishTimer); flushSave(); }\nfunction resetSave() {\n  save = { ...DEFAULT_SAVE, heroes: defaultHeroes(), mastered: [], ownedOrbs: [], unlockedJobs: [...START_JOBS], questCleared: {}, enemySeen: [], titles: [], servants: { owned: [], active: [] } };\n  persist();\n}\n\nfunction discoverEnemy(id) {\n  if (!id || save.enemySeen.includes(id)) return false;\n  save.enemySeen.push(id);\n  persist();\n  return true;\n}\n\nasync function getArtifactCap() {\n  if (artifactCapPromise === undefined) {\n    artifactCapPromise = (window.claude && window.claude.use) ? window.claude.use('artifact').catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null);\n  }\n  return artifactCapPromise;\n}\n\n// Publishing reloads the tab that calls it, so this never fires mid-battle - it just keeps\n// deferring itself every 2.5s until B.running is false, then republishes the whole page with\n// the current save baked in. Three independent ways for\n  // a contiguous literal to break the build; the fix is the same fragment trick every time.\n  const openTag = '<scr' + 'ipt>', closeTag = '<' + '/scr' + 'ipt>';\n  const closeSeq = '<' + '/scr' + 'ipt';\n  const selfMarker = '<' + '!--__SELF__--' + '>';\n  const saveSlot = '/*' + '__SAVE__' + '*/';\n  const templateJson = JSON.stringify(window.PAGE_TEMPLATE).replace(new RegExp(closeSeq, 'gi'), '<\\\\/script');\n  const selfScript = openTag + 'window.PAGE_TEMPLATE = ' + templateJson + ';' + closeTag;\n  const html = window.PAGE_TEMPLATE\n    .replace(saveSlot, JSON.stringify(save))\n    .replace(selfMarker, selfScript);\n  saveDirty = false;\n  try { await cap.publish(html); }\n  catch { saveDirty = true; } // 'conflict' means another view already won and is reloading; anything else, just retry on the next trigger\n}\n\n// --- hero progression ---\nfunction expNeeded(jobId, lv) {\n  const tier = JOBS[jobId].tier;\n  const base = BAL.jobExp.base[String(Math.min(tier, 5))] || 40;\n  return Math.round(base * Math.pow(lv, BAL.jobExp.power));\n}\nfunction isMastered(id) { return save.mastered.includes(id); }\n\n// Kills and training both feed the same hero-instance exp bar - each of the four is its own\n// persistent character, not a shared per-job pool.\nfunction addHeroExp(hero, amount) {\n  if (hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel) return { leveled: 0, mastered: false };\n  hero.exp += Math.round(amount);\n  let leveled = 0;\n  while (hero.lv < BAL.jobExp.maxLevel && hero.exp >= expNeeded(hero.job, hero.lv)) {\n    hero.exp -= expNeeded(hero.job, hero.lv);\n    hero.lv++; leveled++;\n  }\n  let mastered = false;\n  if (hero.lv >= BAL.jobExp.maxLevel && !isMastered(hero.job)) {\n    save.mastered.push(hero.job); mastered = true;\n  }\n  persist();\n  return { leveled, mastered };\n}\n\n// What a hero currently at fromJob/fromLv can evolve into right now.\nfunction evolutionsFor(fromJob, fromLv) {\n  return Object.keys(JOBS).filter(id => {\n    const t = JOBS[id];\n    if (t.titleReq || t.questReq) return false; // special jobs are granted separately, not chosen here\n    // Hybrids: only offer this as a next step to a hero whose CURRENT job is actually one of the\n    // listed prerequisite lineages (not every prerequisite mastered by anyone in the party) -\n    // otherwise any hero, regardless of their own job, could \"転職\" into an unrelated hybrid the\n    // moment two OTHER heroes happened to master its prerequisites (president: この転職ボタン邪魔\n    // ここで出来るのは未進化の転職のみにして - spotted on 勇者, who was showing unrelated\n    // hybrid transfer buttons that had nothing to do with its own odachi->yuusha lineage).\n    if (t.masterReq) return t.masterReq.includes(fromJob) && t.masterReq.every(isMastered);\n    if (t.from && t.from.includes(fromJob)) {\n      const lvOk = fromLv >= (EVOLVE_LV[t.tier] || 5);\n      const examOk = !t.examReq || !!save.questCleared[t.examReq];\n      return lvOk && examOk;\n    }\n    return false;\n  });\n}\nfunction specialJobsAvailable() {\n  return Object.keys(JOBS).filter(id => {\n    const t = JOBS[id];\n    if (!t.titleReq && !t.questReq) return false;\n    if (t.titleReq && !save.titles.includes(t.titleReq)) return false;\n    if (t.questReq && !save.questCleared[t.questReq]) return false;\n    if (t.masterReq && !t.masterReq.every(isMastered)) return false;\n    return true;\n  });\n}\n\n// Any hero can switch into any job the party has already unlocked (reached before, by any\n// hero), free and instant, alongside the normal tree-gated evolution options (president:\n// 操作キャラ全員　解放済みの職業に転職できるように).\nfunction evolveHero(hero, toJob) {\n  const viaTree = evolutionsFor(hero.job, hero.lv).includes(toJob) || specialJobsAvailable().includes(toJob);\n  const viaUnlocked = save.unlockedJobs.includes(toJob);\n  if (!viaTree && !viaUnlocked) return false;\n  if (!isMastered(hero.job)) save.mastered.push(hero.job); // the job just left behind still banks its bonus\n  hero.job = toJob; hero.lv = 1; hero.exp = 0; // weaponLv/orb are the character's own gear - carries over\n  if (!hero.history) hero.history = [];\n  if (!hero.history.includes(toJob)) hero.history.push(toJob);\n  if (!save.unlockedJobs.includes(toJob)) save.unlockedJobs.push(toJob);\n  persist();\n  return true;\n}\n\n// Mastered jobs grant permanent party-wide bonuses - the reason to fully master a job before\n// moving on, even once evolving further is already available.\nfunction supportTotal(id) {\n  let total = 0;\n  for (const jid of save.mastered) {\n    const m = JOBS[jid] && JOBS[jid].master;\n    if (m && m.id === id) total += m.value;\n  }\n  return total;\n}\n\n// --- weapons ---\n// \"武器強化費用\" master bonus (jumi/yariashi/kunoichi/nagae/raifushi lines) used to be labelled\n// refineCost/materialCost for the rejected 精錬/採取 systems (RESEARCH.md's 採用しない list) and\n// did nothing - remapped onto this real, already-live cost formula instead of staying dead flavor\n// text on the job tree screen.\nfunction weaponCost(lv) {\n  return Math.round(BAL.weapon.costBase * Math.pow(BAL.weapon.costPower, lv) * (1 + supportTotal('weaponCost')));\n}\nfunction upgradeWeapon(hero) {\n  if (hero.weaponLv >= BAL.weapon.maxLevel) return false;\n  const cost = weaponCost(hero.weaponLv);\n  if (save.gold < cost) return false;\n  save.gold -= cost; Heroes always attack; there\n// is no rest-to-train toggle (president: 休憩システムいらない).\nconst B = {\n  quest: null, map: null, cell: 40,\n  units: [], enemies: [], shots: [], floats: [], hitfx: [],\n  gold: 0, waveIdx: -1, pending: [], alive: 0,\n  phase: 'idle',   // idle | wave | between | done\n  timer: 0, running: false, lastT: 0, speed: 1,\n};\n\nfunction enemyAbilities(def) {\n  if (Array.isArray(def.abilities)) return def.abilities;\n  return def.ability ? [def.ability] : [];\n}\nfunction hasEnemyAbility(def, id) { return enemyAbilities(def).includes(id); }\n\n// Enemy position is a scalar distance along the path. Knockback is then just a subtraction,\n// which stays correct on corners where an (x,y) nudge would push a unit off the road.\nfunction pathPoint(map, pos) {\n  const p = map.path;\n  const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.floor(pos), p.length - 2));\n  const f = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pos - i));\n  return { x: p[i][0] + (p[i + 1][0] - p[i][0]) * f + 0.5, y: p[i][1] + (p[i + 1][1] - p[i][1]) * f + 0.5 };\n}\n\n// FIDELITY LOCK: fixed four-person formation around ONE horizontal enemy lane.\n// Coordinates are normalised screen positions (0..1), not map tiles.\n// Battlefield order is #1 upper-left, #2 upper-right, #3 lower-left, #4 lower-right.\n// Background art may change per stage; these formation coordinates must not.\nfunction heroAnchors(map) {\n  // Calibrated against the surviving 512px Famitsu battle screenshot: the upper pair sits\n  // around the upper third while the lower pair's badge/gauge row remains fully visible at the\n  // bottom edge of the 0.86-aspect canvas. Keep the left enemy-entry half open and let #4 sit\n  // close to the right edge like reference.\n  return [[0.50, 0.35], [0.80, 0.35], [0.52, 0.72], [0.84, 0.72]];\n}\n\n// FIDELITY LOCK: every enemy uses the same horizontal lane through the gap between\n// upper defenders (#1/#2) and lower defenders (#3/#4). Knockback changes only X,\n// so multiple enemies can overlap on this same lane exactly as in the reference.\nfunction battlePoint(pos) {\n  const len = Math.max(1, B.map.path.length - 1);\n  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pos / len));\n  return { x: 0.05 + t * 0.90, y: 0.565 };\n}\n\nfunction heroStats(hero) {\n  const j = JOBS[hero.job];\n  const orb = hero.orb ? ORBS[hero.orb] : null;\n  const w = BAL.weapon;\n  const atkMul = (1 + (hero.lv - 1) * 0.05) * (1 + hero.weaponLv * w.atkPerLevel) * (orb && orb.atkMul || 1) * servantMul('atkMul');\n  const cdMul = Math.pow(w.cdMulPerLevel, hero.weaponLv) * (orb && orb.cdMul || 1) * servantMul('cdMul');\n  return {\n    atk: j.atk * atkMul,\n    cd: Math.max(180, j.cd * cdMul),\n    pierce: (j.pierce || 0) + (orb && orb.pierceAdd || 0),\n    poison: Math.max(j.poison || 0, orb && orb.poisonAdd || 0),\n    kb: (j.kb || 0) + (orb && orb.kbAdd || 0),\n    coin: (j.coin || 1) * (orb && orb.coinMul || 1),\n    strong: j.strong,\n    bonusVs: orb && orb.bonusVs || null,\n    stun: (j.stun || 0) + (orb && orb.stunAdd || 0),\n    slow: (j.slow || 0) + (orb && orb.slowAdd || 0),\n    debuff: (j.debuff || 0) + (orb && orb.debuffAdd || 0),\n    buff: j.buff,\n    area: orb && orb.area || null,\n    color: j.color, name: j.name, line: j.line, tier: j.tier,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction startQuest(questId) {\n  const q = QUESTS.find(x => x.id === questId);\n\n  B.quest = q; B.map = MAPS[q.map];\n  B.enemies = []; B.shots = []; B.floats = []; B.hitfx = []; B.gold = 0;\n  B.waveIdx = -1; B.pending = []; B.alive = 0;\n  B.phase = 'between'; B.timer = 650; B.speed = 1;\n\n  const anchors = heroAnchors(B.map);\n  B.units = save.heroes.map((hero, i) => ({\n    hero, x: anchors[i][0], y: anchors[i][1], cool: 0, killCoin: 1, attackT: 9999,\n  }));\n\n  showView('v-battle');\n  fitBoard();\n  renderBattleBar();\n  B.running = true; B.lastT = performance.now();\n  requestAnimationFrame(battleLoop);\n  return true;\n}\n\n// The reference battle screen reads as a compact, near-square field with large characters\n// filling most of it - not a long thin strip. The road's tile grid stays fixed (already tuned\n// for wave pacing via simulation), but cells are capped by height as well as width so scaling\n// toward a wider phone doesn't shrink the characters back down.\nfunction fitBoard() {\n  const c = document.getElementById('board');\n  const logicalW = Math.max(280, Math.floor(Math.min(window.innerWidth, 568)));\n\n  // Surviving battle screenshots show a compact near-square combat field. Do not stretch\n  // unit Y positions to fill a modern tall phone; preserve the original formation ratio.\n  const logicalH = Math.max(240, Math.floor(logicalW * 0.86));\n\n  // High-DPI render: keep the exact same layout in CSS pixels but render up to 2x internally\n  // so generated job/enemy art and the painted background stay crisp on modern phones.\n  const dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));\n  c.style.width = logicalW + 'px';\n  c.style.height = logicalH + 'px';\n  c.width = Math.round(logicalW * dpr);\n  c.height = Math.round(logicalH * dpr);\n  B.cell = logicalW / Math.max(1, B.map.cols);\n}\n\nfunction beginWave() {\n  B.waveIdx++;\n  const w = B.quest.waves[B.waveIdx];\n  B.phase = 'wave';\n  B.pending = [];\n  for (const s of w.spawns) {\n    for (let i = 0; i < s.count; i++) B.pending.push({ enemy: s.enemy, at: (s.delay || 0) + i * s.gap });\n  }\n  B.pending.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);\n  B.timer = 0;\n  renderBattleBar();\n}\n\nfunction battleLoop(now) {\n  if (!B.running) return;\n  const raw = Math.min(50, now - B.lastT);\n  B.lastT = now;\n  stepBattle(raw * B.speed);\n  drawBattle();\n  requestAnimationFrame(battleLoop);\n}\n\nfunction stepBattle(dt) {\n  if (B.phase === 'done') return;\n\n  if (B.phase === 'between') {\n    B.timer -= dt;\n    if (B.timer <= 0) {\n      if (B.waveIdx + 1 >= B.quest.waves.length) return finishQuest(true);\n      beginWave();\n    }\n  } else if (B.phase === 'wave') {\n    B.timer += dt;\n    while (B.pending.length && B.pending[0].at <= B.timer) spawnEnemy(B.pending.shift().enemy);\n    if (!B.pending.length && B.alive === 0) {\n      if (B.waveIdx + 1 >= B.quest.waves.length) return finishQuest(true);\n      B.phase = 'between'; B.timer = 850; renderBattleBar();\n    }\n  }\n\n  stepEnemies(dt);\n  if (B.phase === 'done') return;\n  stepUnits(dt);\n\n  for (let i = B.shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { B.shots[i].life -= dt; if (B.shots[i].life <= 0) B.shots.splice(i, 1); }\n  for (let i = B.floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { B.floats[i].life -= dt; if (B.floats[i].life <= 0) B.floats.splice(i, 1); }\n  for (let i = B.hitfx.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { B.hitfx[i].life -= dt; if (B.hitfx[i].life <= 0) B.hitfx.splice(i, 1); }\n}\n\nfunction stepEnemies(dt) {\n  const len = B.map.path.length - 1;\n  for (const e of B.enemies) {\n    if (e.hp <= 0) continue;\n    if (e.stun > 0) e.stun -= dt;\n    if (e.slowT > 0) { e.slowT -= dt; if (e.slowT <= 0) e.slowAmt = 0; }\n    if (e.debuffT > 0) { e.debuffT -= dt; if (e.debuffT <= 0) e.debuffAmt = 0; }\n    if (e.invincibleT > 0) e.invincibleT -= dt;\n    if (e.poison > 0 && e.invincibleT <= 0) { e.poisonT -= dt; if (e.poisonT <= 0) { damage(e, e.poison, true); e.poisonT = 1000; } }\n    if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'haste') && !e.hasted && e.hp / e.maxHp <= e.def.hasteAt) { e.hasted = true; e.baseSpeed *= e.def.hasteMul; }\n    if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'armorbreak') && !e.armorBroken && e.hp / e.maxHp <= e.def.breakAt) { e.armorBroken = true; e.defMul = e.def.breakMul; }\n    if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'invincible') && !e.wasInvincible && e.hp / e.maxHp <= e.def.invincibleAt) { e.wasInvincible = true; e.invincibleT = e.def.invincibleMs; }\n    if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'summon')) {\n      e.summonT -= dt;\n      if (e.summonT <= 0) { e.summonT = e.def.summonMs; for (let i = 0; i < e.def.summonCount; i++) spawnAt(e.def.summonId, e.pos); }\n    }\n    if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'heal') && e.hp > 0 && e.hp < e.maxHp) {\n      e.healT -= dt;\n      if (e.healT <= 0) {\n        e.healT += 1000;\n        // Poison is the intended counter to regeneration: while poisoned, healing is\n        // heavily suppressed instead of merely racing the poison DPS.\n        const healRate = e.poison > 0 ? Math.min(0.012, (e.def.healRate || 0.04) * 0.18) : (e.def.healRate || 0.04);\n        const heal = Math.max(1, Math.round(e.maxHp * healRate));\n        e.hp = Math.min(e.maxHp, e.hp + heal);\n        const p = battlePoint(e.pos);\n        B.floats.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, text: '+' + heal, life: 520, heal: true });\n      }\n    }\n    if (e.stun <= 0) e.pos += (e.baseSpeed * (1 - e.slowAmt) * dt) / 1000;\n    if (e.pos >= len) { e.reached = true; e.hp = 0; }\n  }\n\n  for (let i = B.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n    const e = B.enemies[i];\n    if (e.hp > 0) continue;\n    B.alive--;\n    if (e.reached) {\n      // Original rule: a single monster reaching the right edge fails the defence.\n      sfx.leak();\n      B.enemies.splice(i, 1);\n      return finishQuest(false);\n    }\n    if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'split') && !e.wasSplit) {\n      for (let k = 0; k < e.def.splitCount; k++) spawnAt(e.def.splitInto, e.pos, true);\n    }\n    B.gold += Math.round(e.def.gold * (e.killCoin || 1));\n    sfx.kill(); renderBattleBar();\n    B.enemies.splice(i, 1);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction spawnEnemy(id) { spawnAt(id, 0, false); }\n\nfunction spawnAt(id, pos, isSplit) {\n  const e = ENEMIES[id];\n  discoverEnemy(id);\n  const sc = 1 + B.quest.difficulty * 0.045;\n  B.enemies.push({\n    id, def: e, hp: Math.round(e.hp * sc), maxHp: Math.round(e.hp * sc),\n    pos, speed: e.speed, baseSpeed: e.speed, stun: 0, slowT: 0, slowAmt: 0,\n    debuffT: 0, debuffAmt: 0, poison: 0, poisonT: 0, lastKb: -9999, hasted: false,\n    summonT: e.summonMs || 0, healT: 1000, wasSplit: !!isSplit, defMul: 1, armorBroken: false,\n    invincibleT: 0, wasInvincible: false,\n  });\n  B.alive++;\n}\n\nfunction stepUnits(dt) {\n  for (const u of B.units) {\n    const stats = heroStats(u.hero);\n    u.cool -= dt;\n    u.attackT += dt;\n    if (u.cool > 0) continue;\n    const alive = B.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0);\n    if (!alive.length) continue;\n    // Defenders automatically focus the enemy closest to breaking through the right edge.\n    // Normal attacks are SINGLE-TARGET; area effects belong to explicit 炸裂/爆風 systems,\n    // which will be restored separately instead of making every attack an implicit AoE.\n    const target = alive.reduce((a, b) => (b.pos > a.pos ? b : a));\n    u.cool = stats.cd;\n    fire(u, stats, target);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction grantExp(hero, amount) {\n  const res = addHeroExp(hero, amount);\n  if (res.mastered) sfx.master(); else if (res.leveled) sfx.level();\n}\n\nfunction buffFor(u) {\n  // The whole party stands together, so a support buff simply covers everyone - no range gate.\n  let mul = 1;\n  for (const o of B.units) {\n    if (o === u) continue;\n    const os = heroStats(o.hero);\n    if (!os.buff) continue;\n    mul += os.buff;\n  }\n  return mul;\n}\n\n// Normal attacks strike one target. This preserves the original game's reason for having\n// separate effects such as 炸裂/爆風 instead of making every class an automatic full-screen AoE.\nfunction fire(u, stats, target) {\n  const now = performance.now();\n  const base = stats.atk * buffFor(u);\n  u.attackT = 0;\n\n  // Default attack is one target. Permanent orb unlocks can deliberately add the original\n  // 炸裂/爆風-style area behaviour.\n  applyHit(u, stats, target, base, now);\n\n  if (stats.area) {\n    const others = B.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0 && e !== target);\n    let extra = [];\n    if (stats.area.type === 'burst') {\n      extra = others\n        .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.pos - target.pos) - Math.abs(b.pos - target.pos))\n        .slice(0, stats.area.targets || 2);\n    } else if (stats.area.type === 'all') {\n      extra = others;\n    }\n    for (const e of extra) applyHit(u, stats, e, base * (stats.area.multiplier || 0.35), now, true);\n  }\n\n  const p = battlePoint(target.pos);\n  const areaColor = stats.area && stats.area.color || stats.color;\n  B.shots.push({ x1: u.x, y1: u.y, x2: p.x, y2: p.y, life: 150, color: areaColor, area: stats.area && stats.area.type || null });\n  sfx.hit();\n}\n\n// FIDELITY: jobs keep their own attack rhythm and also read differently at impact.\n// These are compact hit cues only; normal attacks remain single-target and never become AoE here.\nfunction hitfxKind(line) {\n  if (line === 'melee') return 'slash';\n  if (line === 'scout') return 'swift';\n  if (line === 'ranged') return 'arrow';\n  if (line === 'disrupt') return 'seal';\n  if (line === 'support') return 'support';\n  return 'magic';\n}\n\nfunction applyHit(u, stats, e, rawAtk, now, secondary = false) {\n  if (e.invincibleT > 0) {\n    const p = battlePoint(e.pos);\n    B.hitfx.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, life: 220, maxLife: 220, kind: 'magic', color: '#FFFFFF', seed: Math.random() });\n    return;\n  }\n  const strong = stats.strong && stats.strong === e.def.kind;\n  const orbVs = stats.bonusVs && stats.bonusVs[e.def.kind] || 0;\n  const atk = rawAtk * (strong ? BAL.combat.strongMultiplier : 1) * (1 + orbVs);\n  const def = e.def.def * e.defMul * (1 - (e.debuffAmt || 0));\n  let dmg = Math.max(1, Math.floor(atk - def * (1 - stats.pierce)));\n\n  // Original enemy traits restored as actual mechanics rather than flavour text.\n  if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'sturdy')) dmg = 1;\n  if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'barrier') && dmg <= (e.def.barrierCutoff || 12)) dmg = 0;\n\n  const wasAlive = e.hp > 0;\n  if (dmg > 0) damage(e, dmg);\n  else {\n    const p = battlePoint(e.pos);\n    B.floats.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, text: 'GUARD', life: 440, guard: true });\n  }\n\n  // 反動: every damaging hit pushes the enemy toward the village, so mindless rapid-fire can\n  // be actively dangerous. This recreates the original counter-intuitive enemy property.\n  if (dmg > 0 && hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'recoil')) {\n    e.pos = Math.min(B.map.path.length - 1, e.pos + (e.def.recoilStep || 0.18));\n  }\n  // \"任務経験値\" master bonus (ashigaru/nitomusha/kakurizato line) was never actually applied to\n  // the kill-exp that job levels come from (see addHeroExp's comment: kills feed the same exp bar\n  // as 修行) - wiring it here now instead of leaving it decorative on the job tree screen.\n  if (wasAlive && e.hp <= 0) {\n    e.killCoin = stats.coin;\n    grantExp(u.hero, Math.round((e.def.boss ? 70 : 12) * (1 + supportTotal('questExp'))));\n  }\n  if (wasAlive) {\n    const p = battlePoint(e.pos);\n    const orbKind = secondary && stats.area\n      ? (stats.area.type === 'all' ? 'orb-all' : 'orb-burst')\n      : hitfxKind(stats.line);\n    const fxColor = secondary && stats.area && stats.area.color || stats.color;\n    B.hitfx.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, life: 220, maxLife: 220, kind: orbKind, color: fxColor, seed: Math.random() });\n  }\n\n  if (stats.stun) { const t = stats.stun * (1 - (e.def.res.stun || 0)); if (t > 0) e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, t); }\n  if (stats.slow) { const a = stats.slow * (1 - (e.def.res.slow || 0)); if (a > 0) { e.slowAmt = Math.max(e.slowAmt, a); e.slowT = 1500; } }\n  if (stats.debuff) { const a = stats.debuff * (1 - (e.def.res.debuff || 0)); if (a > 0) { e.debuffAmt = Math.max(e.debuffAmt, a); e.debuffT = 3000; } }\n  if (stats.poison && !e.def.poisonImmune) {\n    e.poison = Math.max(e.poison, stats.poison);\n    if (hasEnemyAbility(e.def, 'poisonreact')) {\n      const mul = e.def.poisonHasteMul || 1.12;\n      const cap = e.def.poisonHasteCap || 2.3;\n      e.baseSpeed = Math.min(e.def.speed * cap, e.baseSpeed * mul);\n    }\n  }\n  if (stats.kb) {\n    let amt = stats.kb * (1 - (e.def.res.kb || 0));\n    if (now - e.lastKb < BAL.combat.knockbackDiminishMs) amt *= BAL.combat.knockbackDiminishFactor;\n    e.lastKb = now;\n    e.pos = Math.max(0, e.pos - amt);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction damage(e, amount, isPoison) {\n  e.hp -= amount;\n  const p = battlePoint(e.pos);\n  B.floats.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, text: String(amount), life: 520, poison: !!isPoison });\n}\n\nfunction retireQuest() {\n  if (!B.running || B.phase === 'done') return;\n  finishQuest(false, true);\n}\n\nfunction finishQuest(won, retired = false) {\n  B.phase = 'done'; B.running = false;\n  let resultGold = 0, resultLegend = 0;\n  if (won) {\n    sfx.win();\n    const goldGain = Math.round(B.quest.reward.gold * (1 + supportTotal('questGold')) * servantMul('goldMul'));\n    const legendGain = Math.round((B.quest.reward.legendScore || 0) * (1 + supportTotal('legendGain')));\n    save.gold += goldGain + B.gold;\n    save.legendScore += legendGain;\n    resultGold = goldGain + B.gold;\n    resultLegend = legendGain;\n    save.questCleared[B.quest.id] = true;\n    persist();\n    checkTitles();\n  } else {\n    sfx.lose();\n  }\n  renderBattleResult(won, retired, resultGold, resultLegend);\n}\n\r\n/* --- 30_render.js --- */\r\n// Battle rendering. Units draw from AI-generated original chibi art when available (see\n// loadHeroArt below), falling back to hand-drawn Canvas primitives for every job that doesn't\n// have a piece yet. Everything else (enemies, terrain, effects) stays purely geometric.\n//\n// Rebuild V2 character direction: the body is visually transparent/absent. Hat/helmet, clothes,\n// gloves, boots and weapon may float with small gaps between them. No visible human face or skin.\n// The readable class silhouette comes from oversized equipment and props, matching the original\n// series' defining \"まもりびと\" visual grammar while using newly generated designs.\n\n// Profession art comes only from window.REBUILD_HERO_ART (all 37 jobs).\n// Every character faces left; no legacy per-job JPEG or sprite-sheet fallback is permitted.\nconst HERO_ART_FLIP = new Set(['yuusha', 'ningyoushi', 'dokuyashi']);\n\n// Small profession icons and portraits are derived only from the approved all-37 art.\nconst jobIconCache = {};\nconst heroPortraitCache = {};\n\nfunction getHeroPortrait(jobId) {\n  const art = heroArtCache[jobId];\n  if (!art) return getJobIcon(jobId);\n  if (heroPortraitCache[jobId]) return heroPortraitCache[jobId];\n  const c = document.createElement('canvas');\n  const h = 360, w = 280, dpr = 2;\n  c.width = w * dpr; c.height = h * dpr;\n  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');\n  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);\n  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;\n  ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';\n  const j = JOBS[jobId];\n\n  // FIDELITY: show the complete floating equipment set, never a face/body crop.\n  // Keep the portrait canvas fully transparent. The previous parchment fill, ground shadow,\n  // and tier frame made the character look like a rectangular image pasted onto My Page.\n  // Tier identity belongs to the equipment itself and the surrounding UI, not a baked-in plate.\n  const padX = 16, padTop = 12, padBottom = 10;\n  const scale = Math.min((w-padX*2) / art.bw, (h-padTop-padBottom) / art.bh);\n  const dw = art.bw * scale, dh = art.bh * scale;\n  ctx.drawImage(art.canvas, art.bx, art.by, art.bw, art.bh, (w-dw)/2, h-padBottom-dh, dw, dh);\n\n  const url = c.toDataURL();\n  heroPortraitCache[jobId] = url;\n  return url;\n}\nfunction getJobIcon(jobId) {\n  const size = 56;\n  const dpr = 2;\n  const art = heroArtCache[jobId];\n  const j = JOBS[jobId];\n  if (art) {\n    if (jobIconCache[jobId]) return jobIconCache[jobId];\n    const c = document.createElement('canvas');\n    c.width = size * dpr; c.height = size * dpr;\n    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');\n    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);\n    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;\n    ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';\n\n    // FIDELITY: preserve the whole floating-equipment silhouette in small UI icons.\n    // The previous square crop cut off bows, long blades, staffs and capes, making distinct\n    // jobs look artificially similar. Fit the full extracted subject instead.\n    const pad = 3;\n    const scale = Math.min((size - pad * 2) / art.bw, (size - pad * 2) / art.bh);\n    const dw = art.bw * scale, dh = art.bh * scale;\n    const dx = (size - dw) / 2, dy = size - pad - dh;\n\n    // Quiet parchment plate + ground shadow improve readability without filling the invisible body.\n    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239,225,189,.78)';\n    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);\n    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(35,25,15,.14)';\n    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(size/2, size*0.87, size*0.24, size*0.055, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();\n\n    // Higher jobs get only a restrained outer ring; the actual equipment remains the identity.\n    if (j && j.tier >= 4) {\n      ctx.strokeStyle = j.tier >= 6 ? '#F2D788' : '#C9A75A';\n      ctx.lineWidth = j.tier >= 6 ? 2 : 1;\n      ctx.strokeRect(1.5, 1.5, size-3, size-3);\n    }\n    ctx.drawImage(art.canvas, art.bx, art.by, art.bw, art.bh, dx, dy, dw, dh);\n\n    const url = c.toDataURL();\n    jobIconCache[jobId] = url;\n    return url;\n  }\n  // Never fall back to an obsolete procedural profession icon.\n  // The UI rerenders as soon as the approved art finishes loading.\n  return 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2256%22 height=%2256%22 viewBox=%220 0 56 56%22/%3E';\n}\n\n// Small weapon-tier icon for the party screen (president: 武器見た目追加できるなら). The weapon\n
